svg.title: Unsigned and signed readings of the same 32-bit pattern
svg.desc: 0x00000000 reads 0 both ways; 0x0000000C reads 12 both ways; 0x7FFFFFFF reads 2147483647 both ways (INT32_MAX); 0x80000000 reads 2147483648 unsigned and -2147483648 signed (INT32_MIN); 0xFFFFFFF4 reads 4294967284 unsigned and -12 signed; 0xFFFFFFFF reads 4294967295 unsigned and -1 signed.
svg.text: amber: bit 31 is set, so the signed reading is unsigned − 2^32
